desc.testo: Hang Lung Properties, formerly Amoy Properties and  currently subsidiary of Hang Lung Group, is a property developer in Hong Kong. It is a member of Hang Seng Index Constituent Stocks and is headquartered in the Standard Chartered Bank Building in Central, Hong Kong.
desc.trad: Hang Lung Properties, ex Amoy Properties e attualmente filiale del Hang Lung Group, è un promotore immobiliare con sede a Hong Kong. È membro dell'Hang Seng Index Costituent Stocks e ha sede nello Standard Chartered Bank Building a Central, Hong Kong.
